prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PawTrail game-ready care and furniture character spritesheet. EXACT SAME GIRL as reference: round dark brown glasses, warm medium skin, dark brown hair in low ponytail, sage green overshirt, cream T-shirt, rust-orange shorts, brown shoes, ochre backpack. No hat. Identical clothing, proportions, hair, glasses and palette in every frame. Cozy top-down 3/4 16-bit pixel art, upper-left light, crisp square pixels, no smoothing. The image is a style and identity reference ONLY; ignore its background RGB. Output genuinely transparent background with alpha, no ground/shadows. EXACTLY 4 equal columns x 10 equal rows of complete full-body sprites, equally spaced cells, generous padding, no labels or grid. Feet centered on same baseline; design each cell for native 32x48 export. Four evolving poses per row, natural small action sequence; all props contained within the cell, do not depict any other characters or animals. Row order from top:
1 petting a small animal offscreen, crouch and reach down.
2 feeding, crouch and offer a small food dish.
3 playing, teasing a small toy near feet.
4 refilling water, pour a small bottle downward.
5 cleaning, crouch and wipe.
6 carrying a small supplies box.
7 picking up a tiny furniture item, bend to lift.
8 moving a small furniture box in hands.
9 placing a small item down.
10 inspecting furniture, hand to chin and look down.
No portraits, no scenery, no UI, no text. Same girl recognizable throughout, short rust shorts never change to trousers. Transparent padding in every cell.
